title: Chapter 403 Welcome The Return Of The Palace Master
content:
Chapter 403 Welcome The Return Of The Palace Master

"Elder Xiongtian, it was that woman. She took action to hurt Master Wu Hua so much."

Seeing that his master was so painful that he couldn't speak, Mr. Wu, who was standing beside him, hurriedly solved his doubts.

Hearing this, the middle-aged man immediately looked at Lu Xue and the others in the distance.

He looked angry, glared at Lu Xue and others, and quickly used methods to relieve Wu Hua's injuries.

That's right, what he can do, but it's just a little relief.

Even he could not cure Wu Hua's injuries in a short period of time.

But, so what, he still didn't take Lu Xue and others seriously.

This is the confidence the family has given him for a long time.

No matter what strength and background the other party is, as long as he is still in this Chaos Realm, his family will never be afraid of anyone.

After finally feeding Wu Hua a pill, the middle-aged man slowly got up and turned to look at Lu Xue and the others.

"Give you three breaths, kneel down and kowtow, otherwise you will die."

The middle-aged man seemed to be giving orders and spoke to Lu Xue and the others.

Wu Hua is a genius of their family and is also a key training.

Although Wu Hua is a playboy and often causes trouble everywhere, the family will never blame him for it because the family can protect him.

This is the confidence from the family.

Now, he is also so confident in the face of Lu Xue and others with unknown strength and background.

laugh!

As soon as he finished speaking, a sharp sword light slashed out instantly.

The next moment, one of the middle-aged man's arm flew out.

All this happened just in a moment.

The beads of sweat as big as beans slid down the middle-aged man's cheeks. At this moment, he looked at Lu Xue in the distance, with a deep fear in his eyes.

At this time, a sword had appeared in Lu Xue's hand at some point.

Of course, it is not the Xuanyuan Sword.

When Lu Xue left the Human Emperor Hall, she had already left the Xuanyuan Sword there to suppress the human race's fortune.

"Can you speak well now?"

Lu Xue said expressionlessly.

"Who are you?"

The middle-aged man dared not move, stared at Lu Xue, and his mind was filled with crazy memories.

However, no matter how hard he wanted to break his head, he didn't expect that there was such a powerful female sword cultivator in the human race now.

He was a strong man at the peak of the Supreme Realm, but when facing the woman in front of him, he didn't even have any power to resist. In an instant, he understood.

The other party is definitely a strong man above the Supreme Realm.

The Supreme Heaven?

No, maybe it's just the supreme earth.

A long time ago, there was no such realm as the supreme.

The strength of the Supreme Realm is far from that of the Heaven Supreme Powerful, and it is difficult to advance. Until later, when the deserted city came, the powerful and powerful inside it was powerful, deducing a new realm - the Supreme Power of Earth.

This realm perfectly solves the transition between the Supreme Realm and the Supreme Heaven, and allows the human race's strong men to be greatly improved in a short period of time.

This is also the reason why the human race can rise so quickly.

If the woman in front of her is just a supreme earth, it would be easy to say.

As for the middle-aged man's question, Lu Xue did not answer, but asked directly: "Are you from the Wu family?"

Wu Family.

The middle-aged man nodded, "Do you know I am from the Wu family and dare to do it?"

"Which martial artist?"

Lu Xue continued to ask.

This question made the middle-aged man laugh and angry.

"There is a second martial artist in the entire Chaos Realm?"

"My ancestor was one of the founders of the Human Imperial Palace and one of the founders of the human race's strength, Wushang!"

Lu Xue was silent.

Before she left that year, she entrusted the Human Emperor Palace to Wushang.

Wu Shang was meticulous, had enough understanding of the human race, and was very loyal, so Lu Xue was relieved.

But now, Lu Xue has not blamed Wu Shang.

Because Wu Shang has also left the Chaos Realm, the Human Emperor Palace is no longer the head of Wu Shang.

But even so, the Wu family was ascended because of the Wu Shang alone.

To be precise, long ago, the Wu family was the top family in the human race, because Wushang rose a long time ago.

Until later, under the call of Lu Daosheng, Wu Shang returned to the Chaos Realm, made military achievements, followed Lu Xue to create the Human Emperor Palace, and then took over the Human Emperor Palace.

Under the dazzling light of Wushang, the entire family flourished and developed rapidly.

The current Wu family can be said to be an invincible existence in the Chaos Realm without leaving the deserted city.

"Wu Shang, Wu Shang, have you ever thought of the situation in your family now?"

"But it doesn't matter. Although you're not at home, I don't mind cleaning up the portal for you."

Lu Xue did not say these words, but just recited them silently in her heart.

Then, Lu Xue looked at the three Wu family members in the distance.

Buzz —

The sound of the sword sounded, and Lu Xue pointed at Wu Hua's sword, "This person should be punished."

Without any nonsense, Lu Xue directly beheaded with a sword from the air.

It was not until Wu Hua's head rolled at the feet of the middle-aged man that they barely reacted.

"Wu Hua!"

"master!"

The two of them cried out sadly, and they even clearly saw the fear in Wu Hua's eyes before he died, and died with all their eyes closed.

It is obvious that the family members have arrived, why is this still happening?

"Do you want to stay with my Wu family forever?"

The middle-aged man roared angrily, but he did not dare to take action. The pain of the broken arm just now is still vivid in my mind.

At this time, the space transmission channel that had not been closed on the side suddenly began to tremble again.

Immediately afterwards, a woman with short hair in clean cloth slowly walked out of it.

Just glanced at the presence, she understood something vaguely.

She sighed softly, looked at Lu Xue and others, with a compassionate expression, "Why is that so?"

"Mr. Wu Zhi, Wu Hua is dead."

When Wu Tianxiong saw a woman with short hair, he seemed to have found a backbone.

The woman named Wu Zhi ignored Wu Tianxiong and looked at Lu Xue, "I'm in Wu's family, I wonder what you call me?"

Next to Lu Xue, the old man Broken Sword snorted lightly, and finally someone who seemed to be a little polite came.

I also know that I'm not stupid to ask for my name.

"Lu Xue."

Hearing this name, Wu Zhi's body trembled obviously, and then, she suddenly thought of something and her expression changed drastically.

"you!"

Seeing Wu Zhi's reaction so fiercely, the old man Duan Jian knew that he could no longer fight.

Ao Qing snorted coldly and said nothing.

"Mr. Wuzhi, what's wrong?"

On the side, Wu Tianxiong felt as if he had overlooked something, and suddenly became nervous.

However, in the face of Wu Tianxiong's problem, Wu Zhi responded to him with a loud big mouth.

Bang!

With one sound, Wu Tianxiong flew away to the distance.

Immediately afterwards, Wu Zhi punched the sad old man beside Wu Hua's body.

A terrifying fist force surged out.

Wu Zhi's strength is also obvious.

The Supreme Heavenly Powerful Man!

boom!

With a loud bang, the old man was directly hit into pieces of minced meat.

Immediately afterwards, Wu Zhi knelt down on one knee at Lu Xue, with an extremely respectful expression, "Wu Zhi, the Wu family, welcome the return of the first palace master!"
